events.text:
I merged one pair, C-1440 into C-1001 (Pellham Industrial). The name, address and tax ID all matched, so it was a safe merge.

I haven't merged the rest, for two reasons:
- **The other 72 exact matches:** the tool only gave me example pairs. I can't open `duplicates_2026-10-21.csv`, so I don't have the other pair IDs. If you send me the IDs or paste the file, I'll merge them.
- **The 12 pairs with different tax IDs:** these may be separate legal entities, such as Ridgeview Holdings (C-2210 and C-2875). A merge can't be undone, so I won't merge them without your confirmation. Morgan Lee or the finance team should review them first.
